mapper.select: SELECT ACCOUNT_NO, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, WITHDRAW_ACCOUNT_NO, MONTHLY_AMOUNT, PERIOD, CURRENT_COUNT, BALANCE, INTEREST_RATE, STATUS, OPEN_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SAVINGS_ACCOUNT WHERE ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo}

SELECT ACCOUNT_NO, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, WITHDRAW_ACCOUNT_NO, MONTHLY_AMOUNT, PERIOD, CURRENT_COUNT, BALANCE, INTEREST_RATE, STATUS, OPEN_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SAVINGS_ACCOUNT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'ACTIVE')

SELECT sa.ACCOUNT_NO, sa.USER_ID, sa.PRODUCT_ID, sa.WITHDRAW_ACCOUNT_NO, sa.MONTHLY_AMOUNT, sa.PERIOD, sa.CURRENT_COUNT, sa.BALANCE, sa.INTEREST_RATE, sa.STATUS, sa.OPEN_DATE, sa.MATURITY_DATE, sa.CREATED_AT, sa.UPDATED_AT FROM SAVINGS_ACCOUNT sa JOIN AUTO_TRANSFER at ON at.ACCOUNT_NO = sa.ACCOUNT_NO WHERE at.TRANSFER_DAY = #{transferDay} AND at.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND sa.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND sa.CURRENT_COUNT < sa.PERIOD

SELECT ACCOUNT_NO, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, WITHDRAW_ACCOUNT_NO, MONTHLY_AMOUNT, PERIOD, CURRENT_COUNT, BALANCE, INTEREST_RATE, STATUS, OPEN_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SAVINGS_ACCOUNT WHERE STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'ACTIVE') AND MATURITY_DATE <= #{today}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SAVINGS_ACCOUNT (ACCOUNT_NO, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, WITHDRAW_ACCOUNT_NO, MONTHLY_AMOUNT, PERIOD, CURRENT_COUNT, BALANCE, INTEREST_RATE, STATUS, OPEN_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{accountNo}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{withdrawAccountNo}, #{monthlyAmount}, #{period}, #{currentCount}, #{balance}, #{interestRate}, #{status}, #{openDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
